highlights: OpenAI's GPT-6 models are demonstrating groundbreaking capabilities in protein design, signaling a major advance for scientific applications of AI in biotechnology.

Major platforms like Google Search are integrating advanced Gemini models, while Google Cloud is extending Gemini into specialized verticals like healthcare, showcasing broad commercialization and impact across industries.

The AI ecosystem is rapidly advancing in practical deployments, with new tools emerging for multi-model governance, agentic workflow optimization, and enhanced safety features for critical applications.

agents.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for GitHub Pull Request Review and Fixes
agents.summary: Anthropic's Claude Ship introduces a suite of AI agents, including Code Review (GA) and beta PR Steward/Claude Approvals, designed to automate and enhance GitHub pull request reviews and fixes for developers.

agents.title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
agents.summary: This research introduces 'partial routing,' an approach allowing a lead AI model to delegate suitable subtasks to cheaper worker models based on past performance, significantly improving mean task performance and reducing costs for agentic workflows.

agents.title: Learning to Reason in Real-Time
agents.summary: This paper introduces Real-Time Reasoning Training (RRT) techniques, enabling AI agents to balance reasoning depth with responsiveness in dynamic, real-world environments, showing substantial performance gains over baselines under time pressure.

models.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
models.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 models now exhibit intrinsic capabilities for designing protein structures and sequences, using reasoning and code, with lab tests confirming binding evidence across five targets, marking a significant leap for biotechnology.

models.title: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
models.summary: Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs, which reuses the target's KV cache to avoid additional memory and boosts 64K serving throughput by up to 81%.

models.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
models.summary: Google introduces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a new model iteration that offers native 15-second video generation and editing capabilities with stronger consistency, all at a 30% lower price point, making advanced multimodal tasks more accessible.

tools.title: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
tools.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, an open-source, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux, enabling AI agents to write 'shields' that block exploit paths on running systems without downtime while patches are developed and deployed.

tools.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
tools.summary: Google introduced Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, allowing developers to give their agents access to hundreds of tools while using fewer tokens, significantly enhancing agent capabilities and efficiency.

tools.title: nexos.ai AI Adoption Platform puts 200+ models behind one AI Gateway, with budget limits and governance built in
tools.summary: nexos.ai launched an AI Adoption Platform that provides a single AI Gateway for over 200 models, incorporating built-in budget limits and governance, simplifying multi-model deployment and management for enterprises.

companies.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
companies.summary: Google Search has been upgraded globally with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, promising more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses, marking a significant evolution in Google's core product.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
companies.summary: Google Cloud launched Gemini for healthcare, a specialized AI solution designed to unify clinical data and automate workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burnout and improve efficiency in the healthcare sector.

companies.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
companies.summary: Google and Adobe announced a deeper partnership, integrating creative and productivity tools by enabling PDF editing in Google Drive and incorporating Adobe AI capabilities directly into Gemini, enhancing user workflows across platforms.

learning.title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
learning.summary: This paper introduces 'context scaling' as a critical new dimension for AI system development, focusing on improving the acquisition, representation, and delivery of deployment state to models, emphasizing the model-infrastructure pair as the unit of analysis.

learning.title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
learning.summary: Researchers introduced AutoformBench, a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks from advanced mathematical sources, designed to evaluate AI systems' ability to construct missing definitions and infrastructure for machine-checked proofs, beyond isolated theorem proving.

learning.title: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
learning.summary: Hugging Face provides a comprehensive guide on building, training, and evaluating multi-agent systems, offering practical insights and methodologies for developers working with complex AI collaborations.
